gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP for FY2025-26 and Quarterly Estimates for Q4 (Jan-Mar) FY2025-26, press release June 5, 2026. Q4 FY26 GDP grew 7.8% YoY, down from 8.0% in Q3 FY26; full-year FY26 growth revised up to 7.7% (vs 7.6% Feb advance estimate).

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release for June 2026 (provisional), released July 13, 2026. Headline CPI inflation rose to 4.38% YoY (highest print in six months, above RBI's 4% target), up from 3.93% in May 2026. Food inflation 5.32%, rural 4.74%, urban 3.92%.

gsec10y.source: India 10Y G-Sec benchmark yield ~6.77% as of Aug 8, 2026 (market data via Investing.com); rose 17 bps over July to 6.85% amid higher crude oil prices ($77→$92/bbl), tight banking system liquidity, and postponed Bloomberg EM index inclusion (BusinessToday, Aug 5, 2026).

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC unanimously held the repo rate at 5.25% at its Aug 3-5, 2026 meeting (fourth consecutive hold), retaining a neutral stance. Governor Malhotra cited a need for 'greater clarity' on inflation before acting, noting the above-target CPI print was driven mainly by food/fuel rather than broad-based pressure. Next meeting Oct 5-7, 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, Aug 3-5 2026 meeting (via Forbes India MPC live coverage).

gov_capex.note: FY27 capex push remains on track: Centre exhausted 15.5% of its ₹12.22 lakh crore FY27 capex target in April alone (vs 14.3% in April FY26), and 63 CPSEs' capex rose 26% YoY to ₹2.10 lakh crore in Q1 FY27 — 25% of their annual target — per CGA/CPSE data reported in early July 2026.
gov_capex.source: Business Standard — 'CPSEs meet 25% of FY27 cumulative capital expenditure target in Q1' (July 6, 2026), citing Controller General of Accounts data.

china_plus_one.note: China+1 manufacturing reorientation continues: DPIIT's latest FDI data (released July 27, 2026) shows manufacturing FDI +18% YoY to USD 19.04 bn in FY25. Cabinet's Mar 10, 2026 amendment to Press Note 3 eased China-linked investment (up to 10% non-controlling stake via automatic route) in electronics, capital goods and solar manufacturing, with a 60-day approval fast-track, to deepen supply-chain diversification into India.
china_plus_one.source: DPIIT FDI statistics release (July 27, 2026); Press Note 3 amendment coverage (Carnegie Endowment, KSandK — April/2026, referencing Mar 10, 2026 Cabinet approval).

rural_recovery.note: Kharif sowing gap versus last year narrowed to 2.9% (from 4.7% a week earlier) as of July 31, 2026, but acreage (89.42 mn ha) still trails last year (92.07 mn ha) after the driest June in 12 years; moong, arhar and maize sowing continue to trail. Rising food inflation (5.32% YoY in June) reflects continued supply-side pressure on rural households even as sentiment is expected to improve if the sowing recovery holds.
rural_recovery.source: Business Standard — 'Kharif sowing gap narrows, but moong, arhar and maize trail last year' (Aug 3, 2026).

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty 50 option chain aggregate (total put OI / total call OI) via NiftyInvest/Upstox, as of Aug 8, 2026. OI-based PCR ~0.72-0.73 (call OI notably higher than put OI); separate volume-based PCR ~1.01.
